Platform Engineer
Volta Cloud, Dublin

About the role
Volta Cloud runs managed infrastructure for energy companies. You will build the paved road other teams deploy on.

Requirements
At least 6 years of infrastructure or platform experience.
Deep operational experience with Kubernetes.
Systems programming in Go.
Infrastructure as code with Terraform.
Production operations on AWS.

Nice to have
Monitoring and alerting with Prometheus.

Responsibilities
Design the internal deployment platform.
Set reliability standards and error budgets.
Run infrastructure reviews with product teams.
